name: CaseFocusBorderColorZeroWidth
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "focus-border-color-zero-width" (interaction-states). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: the SAME state-only `border-color` repaint as focus-border-color-state, but the resting plane is `border-width: 0px` over a transparent colour — CSS paints no border at any hue
